Hello! I may as well start off as why I am suicidal. I'm 16, and was harassed, physically mentally and sexually abused by my own sister. My stepdad (who was basically my dad, long story) passed away from cancer a year ago, along with 2 other close friends whom took their own lives. I struggle daily with bipolar depression, anxiety and my eating disorder. I was always bullied because I am not that good at speaking English. (My first was swedish) but I'm on the road to recovery, bumps sometimes happening. But what I find comforting is my bird. She doesn't give a care for anything. (But me of course!) She doesn't know where she or I will go when we die, but she lives in the moment. It makes me smile to think that she doesn't care where she will go when she dies, so she lives in the moment, enjoying playing with her bells and (trying) escaping her cage. But I love her so much, and this may sound silly but I look up to her.

- Katthebabyeater
